decisions.reason: Black-finish range is close to the established offer and cheap to keep, so its option value remains positive while demand uncertainty persists.
The shower channel is close to the established offer and has its own page, indicating ongoing option value with low carrying cost.
The pump-assisted solution is more complex and costly, and with only a website mention it shows limited promise, so the option is not worth keeping given many other options.
Tileable floor drain is a close extension with own-page support and low marginal cost, so the option remains worth holding.
Design grate is close to the core range and well presented, making its option value high relative to its small carrying cost.
